PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?point ?cls ?loc WHERE {
  ?point brick:hasLocation ?loc .
  ?loc rdfs:label "Perimeter_bot_ZN_3" .
  ?point a ?cls .
}

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?point ?loc ?label WHERE {
  ?point a brick:AirTemperature .
  ?point brick:hasLocation ?loc .
  ?loc rdfs:label ?label .
}

        if row[0]==sid and row[1].startswith('2018-07-07'):
            vals.append((row[1], float(row[2])))
vals.sort()
print(len(vals))
for v in vals: print(v)
